blocks.text: Following a successful global photobooth treasure hunt last week, which saw fans unlocking the album title and discovering snippets of unreleased tracks, multi-platinum artist Rex Orange County has announced his forthcoming album, ‘Dream Fatigue’, set for release November 6th. Alongside the announcement comes “Grandma Song”, the album’s second single, offering fans another glimpse into the forthcoming record. Fans can stream the new single and pre-save the album HERE. Co-executive produced by Mustafa and Dylan Wiggins (Rosalía, Justin Bieber), the album features contributions from Turnstile’s Brendan Yates, Dev Hynes, Daniel Caesar, Mustafa, dexter in the newsagent and Taylor Skye of Jockstrap.
